strings.status.info: This Mac is a LemonGalaxy worker: several accounts can sign in at once, and each sees and controls it from its own device list. All of these settings can only be changed on this Mac — never by the server or a controller.
strings.status.startFailed: The remote service failed to start: {0}
strings.status.permMissing: Screen Recording or Accessibility isn't granted yet, so others can't see the screen or use the mouse and keyboard.
strings.status.needsRelogin: An account was reset by the administrator and must sign in again.
strings.status.remoteDisabled: Remote access is disabled: no account can connect and assistance is unavailable.
strings.status.welcome.title: Sign in to accept remote control
strings.status.welcome.body: You can sign in several accounts on the same server. This Mac appears in each account's device list.
strings.events.info: Every connection, file operation and command is logged on this Mac. AI actions are marked; refused connections and blocked AI actions are warnings.
strings.accounts.info: Each account has its own permissions on this Mac. Limits are enforced here even if a controller asks for more. All accounts must be on the same server.
strings.accounts.server.info: All signed-in accounts are on this server. Sign out every account to switch servers.
strings.accounts.needsRelogin: Reset by the administrator — sign in again
strings.accounts.signOut.title: Sign out {0}?
strings.accounts.signOut.body: This account's sessions end immediately and this Mac is removed from its device list. It has to sign in again to control this Mac.
strings.perm.aiCap.info: The most this account's AI may do on this Mac. A controller can't go above it; Off blocks AI entirely.
strings.perm.notify.info: Shows a banner with a disconnect button at the top right when this account connects or its AI acts. The menu bar icon always changes.
strings.perm.systemUser.info: The macOS worker runs as the signed-in macOS user: terminal, files and commands only have that user's permissions.
strings.login.title: Sign in
strings.login.server.info: Copy the full address from the admin console's Server page: host:port#sha256-fingerprint. The fingerprint is pinned, so a replaced certificate is refused.
strings.login.server.locked: Accounts are already signed in on this server, and all accounts must share one server. Sign them all out to switch.
strings.login.systemUser: Remote control runs as macOS user {0}
strings.login.totp.title: Two-factor authentication
strings.login.totp.prompt: Enter the 6-digit code from {0}'s authenticator app.
strings.login.change.title: Set a new password
strings.login.change.prompt: Set your own password for the first sign-in.
strings.login.change.info: The new password never leaves this Mac (OPAQUE), so neither the server nor the administrator learns it. If you forget it, the administrator can reset it and every device must sign in again.
strings.login.change.tooShort: The new password needs at least 8 characters
strings.assist.info: Tell your helper both codes. They enter them in their LemonGalaxy app, and the session starts only after you click Allow. The verification code is generated here and never passes through the server.
strings.assist.custom.info: 8–16 letters or digits. Can't be changed during a session.
strings.assist.remoteDisabled: Remote access is disabled. Allow it again at the bottom left first.
strings.assist.request.title: Someone wants to control this Mac
strings.assist.request.info: Once allowed, they can see the screen, use the mouse and keyboard, terminal and files. Disconnect any time from the menu bar or the banner. Requests expire after 2 minutes.
strings.perm.info: Remote control needs two system permissions that only you can grant: click Open System Settings and turn on LemonGalaxyWorker (if it isn't listed, click + and choose it from Applications). This page updates automatically; Screen Recording may need the app to be reopened.
strings.perm.screen.purpose: Lets others see this Mac's screen and hear its sound; also used for AI screenshots. Without it only terminal and files work.
strings.perm.accessibility.purpose: Lets others use the mouse and keyboard and turn on the privacy screen; also lets AI read on-screen controls. Without it others can only watch.
strings.general.loginItem.info: Starts in the menu bar after you log in to macOS. If you move the app, turn this off and on again.
strings.general.loginItem.unavailable: Only the installed app (in Applications) can open at login.
strings.general.systemNotifications.info: Posts a notification when someone connects or asks for assistance. macOS asks for permission the first time.
strings.general.assistSound: Play a sound for assistance requests
strings.general.menuIconHint: The menu bar icon shows a red dot while someone is connected, an orange dot for AI activity or pending requests, and a slash when remote access is disabled.
strings.general.language.info: Applies immediately. A new language only needs a file in the app's Locales resource folder.
strings.notify.connected.title: Someone connected to this Mac
strings.notify.connected.body: {0} connected from device {1}. Disconnect from the menu bar icon.
strings.status.quietAccount: Alerts are off for this account
strings.assist.noAccount: No account yet. Enter a server address to start assistance.
strings.assist.noAccount.info: Assistance is paired through a server and needs no account. Copy the address from the admin console's Server page (host:port#sha256-fingerprint). It is remembered, and accounts signed in later must be on the same server.
strings.assist.viaServer.info: Without an account, assistance is paired through this server. After you sign in, the account's server is used.
strings.login.server.inUse: Assistance is currently paired through this server. Signing in to an account on another server ends the assistance and switches to that server.
strings.update.info: Asks your server for new versions using any signed-in account. Updates with an invalid signature or missing from the signed list are refused, and downloads are checked against SHA-256. Checked automatically once a day while online.
strings.update.needAccount: Sign in an account to check for updates
strings.update.title: New version available
strings.update.noNotes: No release notes for this version
strings.update.verified: Release signature verified; the download is checked against SHA-256
strings.update.downloaded: {0} was saved to Downloads and opened. Drag LemonGalaxyWorker into Applications to replace the old version, then reopen it. Accounts and permissions are kept.
strings.general.lockOnEnd: Lock screen when remote sessions end
strings.general.lockOnEnd.info: After someone has viewed this Mac's desktop remotely, the screen locks 10 seconds after all such sessions have ended. Automatic reconnects after a dropped connection do not trigger it, and terminal- or file-only sessions do not count.
strings.headless.title: Headless display
strings.headless.info: When this Mac has no active display (a Mac mini without a monitor, a laptop with its lid closed), a virtual display is added as soon as someone opens the display list remotely, so remote desktop keeps working. It is removed 10 seconds after all remote sessions end. Default: 1920×1080 at 60 Hz.
strings.headless.unsupported: This version of macOS doesn't support virtual displays, so none will be added
strings.unattended.title: Unattended access
strings.unattended.info: When on, networking and remote control move to a system background service: this Mac stays online after it starts up even if nobody logs in, someone logs out or switches users, and the login window can be viewed and operated remotely. Signed-in accounts and the device identity are handed over to the background service; the menu bar app only shows status and settings. An administrator approves it once in System Settings. On a Mac with FileVault, someone must unlock the disk at the startup screen after a restart before remote control works.
strings.unattended.unavailable.notBundled: Only an installed app can turn this on; development builds are not supported.
strings.unattended.locationHint: Move LemonGalaxyWorker to the Applications folder before turning this on. If you move the app later, turn this off and on again.
strings.unattended.approval: Allow LemonGalaxyWorker to run in the background in Login Items.
strings.unattended.approval.info: Open System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions and turn on LemonGalaxyWorker under Allow in the Background (an administrator password is required). This page updates automatically, and the app reopens once so the background service takes over networking.
strings.unattended.starting: Waiting for the background service to start…
strings.unattended.migrating: Handing accounts and the device identity over to the background service…
strings.unattended.screen.info: Remote video and input come from the session currently shown on the display: the login window, or the user using this Mac. It follows logins, logouts and fast user switching, and remote views in progress continue.
strings.unattended.service.info: The background service runs as the system; terminals, commands and files run as the user each account maps to. To reach protected folders such as Documents and Desktop, turn on LemonGalaxyWorker in Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access. Logs are in /Library/Logs/LemonGalaxyWorker-daemon.log and /Library/Application Support/LemonGalaxy/logs.
strings.unattended.nonAdmin: You are not an administrator: you can only manage accounts mapped to you, and turning this off does not bring the device identity back from the background service.
strings.unattended.disable.title: Turn off unattended access?
strings.unattended.disable.body: This Mac will only be online while you are logged in with this app open, and the login window can no longer be controlled remotely. Accounts and the device identity move back to the current user, and the app reopens once.
strings.unattended.disable.bodyNonAdmin: This Mac will only be online while someone is logged in with this app open, and the login window can no longer be controlled remotely. You are not an administrator, so the accounts and device identity in the background service cannot be moved back; the data this user had before is used instead. The app reopens once.
strings.unattended.unreachable: Cannot reach the background service. Try again shortly.
strings.unattended.removedElsewhere: The background service was turned off or removed in System Settings.
strings.unattended.relaunching: Switching modes; the app will reopen automatically…
strings.unattended.denied: Only administrators or the person using this Mac can manage the background service
strings.unattended.notYourAccount: This account maps to another system user; only an administrator can change it
strings.unattended.noService: The remote service has not started yet
strings.unattended.noIdentity: The background service has no device identity yet
strings.unattended.alreadyClaimed: The background service already has accounts and cannot import another identity
strings.unattended.assistAdmin: Under unattended access, assistance terminals and files run as the system; only an administrator can start or allow it
strings.paste.window.title: Copy
strings.paste.error.watch: Could not watch for folder changes
strings.paste.daemonGone: Lost connection to the background service
strings.paste.loginWindow: Files cannot be pasted at the login window
